site.tagline: Bike repair in Millbrook, done the same week.
site.intro: Tune-ups, wheels, brakes and e-bikes, fixed by two mechanics who ride every day. Walk in or call ahead.
site.description: Bike repair and tune-ups on Market Street, Millbrook. Hours, prices and directions.

notice.text: Winter tune-up booking opens November 1. Book early: last year we were full by the 10th.

streams.title: Workshops & rides
streams.intro: Free, open to everyone, bring your own bike.

site.about:
Alder & Pine opened in 2014 in the old hardware store on Market Street. Two mechanics, one dog, and a back room full of parts for bikes older than we are.

We fix what you bring us and tell you what it will cost before we start. No upselling: if your chain has another thousand miles in it, we'll say so.

Fully insured. Certified for the e-bike systems most shops in town won't touch.
site.footer_line: Licensed and insured · Business licence 2014-0381 · Pickup and drop-off across Millbrook and the river towns

data.name: Basic tune-up
data.description: Gears and brakes adjusted, wheels trued, chain cleaned and lubed, a safety check bolt to bolt.

data.name: Full overhaul
data.description: Strip down, deep clean, new cables and housing, bearings serviced. Your bike comes back like new.

data.name: Flat fix
data.description: While you wait, most of the time. Tubeless set-ups too.

data.name: E-bike service
data.description: Motor and battery check, firmware updates, brake bleed. Most major systems.

data.name: Wheel build
data.description: Hand-built wheels to your weight, riding and budget. Ask for a quote.

data.name: Bike fit
data.description: An hour on the stand: saddle, bars and cleats set for your body, notes to take home.

data.name: Dana R.

data.description: They told me my old bike was worth fixing when the big shop said to buy a new one. Rides better than it did new.

data.name: Marcus T.
data.subtitle: Commutes every day

data.name: Priya K.

data.name: Do I need an appointment?
data.description: No. Walk in any time we're open. For a tune-up in spring, booking ahead gets it back sooner.

data.name: Do you work on e-bikes?
data.description: Yes, most major motor systems. Bring the charger if the battery is involved.

data.name: Can you pick up my bike?
data.description: Yes, anywhere in Millbrook for $20 each way, free with a full overhaul.

data.title: Winter tune-ups: book from November 1
data.summary: Twenty percent off a basic tune-up from November to February.
data.body:
Winter is the quiet season, so it's the best time to get your bike ready for spring.

- **Basic tune-up**: $52 instead of $65
- **Full overhaul**: $150 instead of $180

Book online or call the shop.
